reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the NTI file-naming change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #8668 by preventing the NTI connector from using file hashes as observable names, so unnamed files retain hash-only STIX IDs. **Changes:** - Set File names only when supplied by the feed and remove the unused hash-name import. - Add regression tests for unnamed MD5 and SHA-256 files and preservation of feed-provided names. - Add test dependencies and source-path setup. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `external-import/​nti/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_file_observable.py` | Tests hash-only IDs and preservation of feed-provided names. | | `external-import/​nti/​tests/​test-requirements.txt` | Adds pytest and connector dependencies for tests. | | `external-import/​nti/​tests/​conftest.py` | Makes connector source modules importable in tests. | | `external-import/​nti/​src/​nti/​converter_to_stix.py` | Removes the hash fallback for File names and its unused import. |
Review effort: Balanced
